text: CHIEF PRE-CANDIDATE HOLD on current 366-line draft; two leakage doors plus one terminology repair. (1) Section 4 says provider selection uses leave-family-out evidence but does not confine that selection to the development partition. The calibration court must begin only after provider, geometry, candidate policy, cost model except the floor, and transitions were selected under a separately frozen development-only protocol. Calibration labels may select only externalFloor; untouched test may select nothing. If leave-family-out is used, say it occurs entirely within development. (2) Section 7 permits maximum E_low/E_high/R_bal, candidate-miss/support-failure limits and required control margin to be frozen merely before test unsealing. Those are promotion/refusal rules and must be frozen before calibration outcomes are opened, from prior scientific requirements or development evidence; otherwise the calibration result chooses its own acceptance bar. (3) Use source-lineage-group consistently in the deletion stability rule and condition 3; do not switch back to leave-one-story-out when editions/derivatives are indivisible. Required mutations: allowing calibration labels into provider choice, or setting a promotion limit after calibration results, must fail the protocol audit. No other chief finding in the current draft; nomination-provenance blocking, model-relative P/F language, bidirectional loss, honest null, support failures, controls and WOG diagnostic-only status are sound.
